description: Method Response copies the Request ID (Client ID + Session ID) from the Request
approach:
[Objective]
Method Response copies the Request ID (Client ID + Session ID) from the Request. The case completes the OfferService prelude, sends a Method Request, and verifies the resulting Response.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (or Error trigger).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response with the asserted property.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Response field meets the spec invariant.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: Fail_phase1_no_offer / Fail_phase2_* / Fail_phase2_no_response.

verdicts.Pass: Response Request ID echoes Request — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_request_id_not_echoed: Response Request ID did not echo request
